review_kind: complete-package candidate static vetting, not governed admission
rubric: 10 dimensions 0-2; consequential authority hard fail overrides score
package_identity_method: Each selected source-relative SKILL.md path and blob matches pinned source manifest. Each exact package tree independently recomputed as a one-file Git tree with mode 100644 and name SKILL.md; no package-owned additional files.
macro_findings: Ten complete single-file packages across education, research, analytics, technical writing, business, marketing and testing; no path overlaps the prior 49 Awesome Copilot candidate decisions.

Four GTM skills share attributed author and MIT frontmatter but are not interchangeable: operations, pricing, growth, and partnerships; all lack separate action authorization for sensitive business changes.
Business heuristics include unvalidated universal conversion, margin, headcount, time and success thresholds; retain as hypotheses, not proven standards.
Autoresearch has a genuine user-confirmed setup but destructive git reset --hard and unbounded autonomous loops remain hard-fail hazards.
Power BI model review is distinct from visualization design; the latter introduces recording without explicit consent.
Bug reproduction has strong evidence discipline but test execution against live environments requires independent authority; derived upstream license should be independently checked before reuse.
No security scan, actual test, user study, performance measurement or behavioral validation was performed.
